title: Darwin Predicted a Moth With an 11-Inch Tongue

scenes.text: Darwin predicted a moth with an eleven-inch tongue, and nobody believed him.
In 1862 he got a Madagascan orchid with a nectar tube nearly a foot deep.
He reasoned some insect must have a tongue long enough to reach the bottom.
In 1867 Wallace agreed, and in 1903 the moth was found.
Its tongue can reach twenty-eight centimeters.
The orchid lock had a key all along.

description:
In 1862 Darwin predicted a moth with an extremely long tongue to pollinate a Madagascan orchid. The moth was found in 1903.
Its tongue reaches up to 28.5 cm.
What other prediction came true decades later?
